About U&I: U&I is a volunteer-driven NGO transforming lives through education. We work with children from underserved communities, providing after-school learning support, life skills training, and career guidance to help them break the cycle of poverty.
About the center:
A centre of U&I is our Kanasu, the Jayanagar center. It is a vibrant all-boys learning space launched in 2023. With 40 kids and 37 dedicated volunteers, it quickly flourished into one of India's largest centers, now supporting 73 kids in 2024-25.
The children at Kanasu, primarily from primary and middle school, bring boundless energy and curiosity. In 2024-25, the center ran two key programs: a Foundational Literacy program on Saturdays for all kids and a Foundational Numeracy program on Sundays for middle schoolers. With 50 volunteers spread across 5 Learning Circles on Saturdays, the center maintains an almost 1:1 teacher-to-student ratio, while Sundays achieve a perfect 1:1 ratio with 15 volunteers.
From solving riddles to sketching their imaginations on paper, the kids here thrive in an environment that nurtures their love for learning through play and creativity.
